[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Bilpin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Alliance Security]] agent who, in [[44 ABY]], sent [[Myri Antilles]] to [[Mission to the Galactic Princess|investigate]] the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Oobolo]], captain of the ''[[Galactic Princess]]'', for suspected criminal activity. For the operation, Antilles was to wear experimental [[recording crystal]]s of Bilpin's design. However, the crystals were not as secure as Bilpin hoped, given that Oobolo was able to jam them both ways. With contact with Antilles cut off, GAS was forced to send the legendary [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to extract his daughter.<ref name="Roll">{{InsiderCite|135|Roll of the Dice}}</ref>
